Root permission will be checked and the companion module installed or updated. If a reboot is required, reboot the device and check again before enabling enhancement.\n\nThe module runs local automatic tasks in a separate background process without periodically opening the ReaMicro interface. Tasks may be delayed during deep sleep. If the system stops the background task service, try Sync tasks to restart it or reboot the device.

New automatic tasks will stop, and the current task will be allowed to finish safely before progress is saved back to the app. The copy of account credentials stored by the Root module will then be cleared and the companion module disabled in the manager.\n\nModule files and in-app task data are retained. Tasks can only run manually afterward; no alternative automatic wake method is enabled.

Automatic tasks will be stopped and progress saved. Pending module installation or updates will then be cancelled, and removal requested through your current Root manager.\n\nModule removal usually requires a device reboot. Follow the manager instructions. In-app task data is retained, and this app will not reboot the device automatically.
Root enhancement is disabled and the companion module has been removed. In-app task data is retained.

Allow this app on the Superuser page in your current KernelSU, Magisk, or APatch. In Magisk, Superuser access must allow apps. If you changed the SU path in APatch, enter the same path above. Only your current manager is needed; do not install additional managers.

The companion module appears on the Modules page in your current Root manager with the ID reamicro_automation. Completing installation or an update does not always mean it is active. If prompted, reboot the device and check again. It only handles background tasks and does not modify system mounts; no mounting metamodule is required.

This service only handles automatic tasks for this app, not system tasks or tasks for other apps. The page shows the state at the last check. Tap Check Root for the latest status. Activity records are stored on this device and do not prove network success or task completion. See Records for results. Updates may pause during deep sleep.
